description: Department of Justice Inspector General Michael E. Horowitz announced the release of a report of an investigation into Epstein's care at the Metropolitan Correction Center. The review identified: "numerous and serious failures by MCC New York staff," "long-standing operational challenges," and "no evidence contradicting the FBI’s determination that there was no criminality associated with Epstein’s death."
headline: Department of Justice OIG Releases Report on the Federal Bureau of Prison's Custody, Care, and Supervision of Jeffrey Epstein
